omission_scope: Raw pixels, frame digest dictionaries, frame-index lists, episode joint observations, native traces and full runtime report stay outside Git. Rollups hash UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators. The full report retains every digest/index. No attempted chapter or release frame is omitted from the movies.
